title: Query current CRM opportunities
intent: Read sales opportunities currently visible to the signed-in Twenty user.
instructions: Call query_opportunities for current workspace data; do not answer from Skill text or stale page content.
Use name_contains only when the user supplied an opportunity-name filter.
To open one opportunity, require exactly one API match and call goto with that result's exact ui_path.
After goto, observe the target record before reporting completion.
For zero or multiple matches, ask for clarification rather than inventing a route.
